svg.title: Raven bird
svg.desc: The one raven of Raven, generated from raven-ios Shared/RavenFigure.swift. Units: a 120 by 100 box facing right, feet at (66, 90). Each pose is a group (id = pose name); its parts have ids pose-part and classes tail, body, wing, head, beak, eye, eye-shut, legs. Light colours by default, dark under prefers-color-scheme: dark (or add class dark to the svg).
